name: Exercise Ball Crunch
steps: Sit on an exercise ball and walk your feet forward until your lower back rests on it.
Keep feet flat and wide, and cross your arms on your chest.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower slowly back over the ball.
cues: Breathe out as you curl up

common_mistakes.fix: Widen the feet and move slowly
Cross the arms on the chest
Curl up only until the stomach is fully tight
